source_title: Soundcore Boom 2 Plus falls to one of its best prices
source_excerpt:
Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.
The Soundcore Boom 2 Plus is down to $169.99 on Amazon right now, which cuts $80 off its $249.99 retail price. That’s a 32% discount relative to the RRP, and it’s a strong price for a big outdoor speaker that doesn’t often dip much lower.
This is the kind of deal that stands out because it’s been cheaper only once before, and only by about $9. For anyone waiting for a worthwhile drop instead of a tiny price cut, this one is worth a look now.
The Boom 2 Plus is a large boombox-style portable Bluetooth speaker made for outdoor use. It delivers up to 140W of power and uses a 2-woofer plus 2-tweeter setup, with BassUp to boost the low end. It’s built for open spaces, parties, and anywhere you want bigger audio than a small portable speaker can give you.
You also get IPX7 waterproofing, and the speaker is said to float, which makes it a good fit for pool days, beach trips, and rainy weather. Battery life is rated at up to 20 hours, and it supports Bluetooth 5.3 with long wireless range. Other extras include customizable lighting, app controls, and a built-in power bank to charge other devices.
It’s also backed by a 4.5-star Amazon rating, which adds some extra confidence if you’re shopping for a speaker in this size class. At $169.99 on Amazon, this is a rare chance to grab the Soundcore Boom 2 Plus at one of its best prices we’ve seen.
